breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — History Unit 4: Intellectual Awakening and Socio-Political Changes — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Confucius was born in the Shantung province of China in 551 BCE. He is the author of five important works: Book of Records, Book of Odes, Book of Changes, Spring and Autumn Annals, Book of History.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the five works attributed to Confucius in the textbook?
en.explanation: The Tao Teh Ching was written by Lao-Tse.

ta.q: பாடநூல் கன்பூசியஸுக்குக் கூறும் ஐந்து நூல்களில் இடம்பெறாதது எது?

questions.quote: Zoroastrianism: Zoroaster of Persia proclaimed one god, Ahura Mazda (the Lord of Light). Fire was worshipped as a symbol of the deity. Sacrifice and image worship were discarded.

en.q: Zoroaster proclaimed one god, who is called:
options: Ahura Mazda, the Lord of Light
en.explanation: Ahura Mazda is the Lord of Light; fire is his symbol.

ta.q: ஜோராஸ்டர் அறிவித்த ஒரே கடவுளின் பெயர் என்ன?
ta.explanation: அஹுரா மஸ்டாவின் அடையாளம் தீ; பலியும் உருவ வழிபாடும் கைவிடப்பட்டன.

questions.quote: Ahura Mazda has seven qualities: light, good mind, right, dominion, piety, well-being and immortality. He is omniscient, omnipotent and omnipresent.

en.q: Ahura Mazda is described as omniscient, omnipotent and omnipresent. Omnipresent means:
en.explanation: Omniscient – knows everything; omnipotent – all powerful; omnipresent – everywhere.

ta.q: அஹுரா மஸ்டா அனைத்துமறிந்தவர், அனைத்தும் வல்லவர், எங்கும் நிறைந்தவர் எனப்படுகிறார். 'எங்கும் நிறைந்தவர்' என்பதன் பொருள்?

questions.quote: Three more Vedas (Yajur, Sama, Atharva) were composed after the Rig Veda. Brahmanas, Aranyakas and Upanishads were compiled in the upper Gangetic plain during 1000–600 BCE.

en.q: Which texts contain knowledge to be learnt secretly in the forest?
en.explanation: Aranyakas are commentaries on Rig Vedic hymns to be learnt in the forest; Brahmanas are manuals of rituals.

ta.q: காட்டில் இரகசியமாகக் கற்க வேண்டிய அறிவைக் கொண்ட நூல்கள் எவை?
ta.explanation: ஆரண்யகங்கள் காட்டில் கற்கும் அறிவைக் கூறும் விளக்கவுரைகள்; பிராமணங்கள் சடங்கு வழிகாட்டிகள்.

questions.quote: Vardhamana Mahavira was born in 599 BCE at Kundagrama near Vaishali. His mother was Trishala, a Lichchavi princess. He married Yashoda; at thirty he left home; in the thirteenth year of asceticism acquired the highest knowledge. He died at Pawapuri in 527 BCE at the age of seventy two.

en.q: Mahavira died at Pawapuri in 527 BCE at the age of:
en.explanation: Born 599 BCE, died 527 BCE at 72; Buddha died at 80.

ta.q: மகாவீரர் கி.மு. 527-இல் பாவாபுரியில் எந்த வயதில் இறந்தார்?
ta.explanation: கி.மு. 599-இல் பிறந்து 72-ஆம் வயதில் இறந்தார்; புத்தர் 80-இல் இறந்தார்.

questions.quote: Gautama Buddha was the son of Suddhodana, chief of the Sakyas of Kapilavastu. His given name was Siddhartha. Born in 567 BCE in Lumbini Garden. His mother Mayadevi died after a few days. Married Yashodhara; son Rahula.

en.explanation: Siddhartha married Yashodhara and had a son Rahula.

questions.quote: When Buddha's closest disciple Ananda asked whether women can become monks, Buddha said, Yes, if women can follow the path of renunciation, they can become monks and completely enlightened just as men.

en.q: Which disciple of Buddha asked whether women could become monks?
en.explanation: Buddha replied that women could also become monks and be enlightened.

ta.q: பெண்கள் துறவியாகலாமா என்று புத்தரிடம் கேட்ட நெருங்கிய சீடர் யார்?
ta.explanation: பெண்களும் துறவு நெறியில் ஞானம் பெறலாம் என்று புத்தர் பதிலளித்தார்.

questions.quote: Decline of Buddhism: later texts in Sanskrit; split into Hinayana and Mahayana; loss of royal patronage during the Guptas; invasions of Huns and Turks.

en.q: Which of the following was NOT a reason for the decline of Buddhism in India?
options: Use of Sanskrit in later texts
en.explanation: Buddhism lost royal patronage during the Gupta period.

ta.explanation: குப்தர் காலத்தில் பௌத்தம் அரச ஆதரவை இழந்தது.

questions.quote: Ajivika – founder Gosala (Maskariputra Gosala), a friend of Mahavira. Ajivikas rejected the karma theory. Under the Cholas, a special tax was levied on them. Manimekalai (Buddhists), Nilakesi (Jains) and Sivajnanasiddhiyar (Saivites) contain outlines of Ajivika doctrine.

en.q: The founder of the Ajivika sect, who rejected the karma theory, was:
en.explanation: Gosala was a friend of Mahavira who later founded the Ajivika sect.

ta.q: கர்மக் கொள்கையை மறுத்த ஆசீவகப் பிரிவை நிறுவியவர் யார்?
ta.explanation: கோசலர் மகாவீரரின் நண்பர்; பின்னர் ஆசீவகப் பிரிவை நிறுவினார்.

questions.quote: Gana-sanghas: clan oligarchies; single clan such as the Shakyas, Koliyas and Mallas, or a confederacy of clans such as the Vrijjis and the Vrishnis (at Vaisali). Only two strata: Kshatriya rajakula and dasa-karmakara.

en.q: Which of the following was a confederacy of clans (gana-sangha) located at Vaisali?
en.explanation: Shakyas, Koliyas and Mallas were single-clan sanghas; the Vrijjis formed a confederacy.

ta.q: வைசாலியில் அமைந்த குலக் கூட்டமைப்பாகிய கண சங்கம் எது?
ta.explanation: சாக்கியர், கோலியர், மல்லர் தனிக்குலங்கள்; வஜ்ஜிகள் குலக் கூட்டமைப்பு.

questions.quote: Sixteen mahajanapadas: Kasi, Kosla, Anga, Magadha, Vajji, Malla, Chedi, Vatsa, Kuru, Panchala, Matsya, Surasena, Assaka, Avanti, Gandhara and Kamboja.

en.q: Intellectual Awakening and Socio-Political Changes: Which of the following was NOT one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas?
en.explanation: Kalinga is not in the list; it was conquered later by Ashoka.

ta.explanation: கலிங்கம் பட்டியலில் இல்லை; பின்னர் அசோகர் வென்றார்.

questions.quote: Bimbisara was the first important king of Magadha. Through matrimonial alliances with the Lichchavi clan of Vaishali and the ruling family in Kosala, he conquered Anga. Village (grama) was the basic unit; gramani headman. Land tax (bali). Shadbhagin – one entitled to one-sixth.

en.q: The term 'shadbhagin' in Magadha's revenue system referred to:
options: the king, entitled to one-sixth of the produce
en.explanation: Shadbhagin – one entitled to a share of one-sixth, i.e. the king.

ta.q: மகதத்தின் வருவாய் முறையில் 'சட்பாகின்' என்பது யாரைக் குறிக்கிறது?
options: விளைச்சலில் ஆறில் ஒரு பங்குக்கு உரிய மன்னர்

questions.quote: Ajatashatru murdered his father and ascended the throne in 493 BCE. Capital Rajagriha was surrounded by five hills. He built a fort at Pataligrama, which later became Pataliputra. Nandas were the first non-kshatriya dynasty; Mahapadma Nanda.

en.q: Ajatashatru built a fort at which place on the Ganges that later became Pataliputra?
en.explanation: Pataligrama later became the Mauryan capital Pataliputra.

ta.q: அஜாதசத்ரு கங்கைக் கரையில் கட்டிய, பின்னர் பாடலிபுத்திரமாக மாறிய கோட்டை எங்குள்ளது?
ta.explanation: பாடலிகிராமமே பின்னர் மௌரியத் தலைநகர் பாடலிபுத்திரம் ஆனது.

questions.quote: Chandragupta Maurya defeated the Nanda king in 321 BCE with Chanakya's help. Seleucus, the general of Alexander, was defeated by Chandragupta. Megasthenes' Indica. Bindusara extended the empire up to Karnataka.

en.q: Who was the envoy of Seleucus who stayed in India and wrote Indica?
en.explanation: Megasthenes' Indica is a record of Mauryan polity and society.

ta.q: இந்தியாவில் தங்கி இண்டிகாவை எழுதிய செலூக்கஸின் தூதர் யார்?
ta.explanation: மெகஸ்தனிஸின் இண்டிகா மௌரிய அரசியல், சமூகம் குறித்த பதிவு.

questions.quote: Mauryan municipal administration: nagaraka; six committees with five members each. Military department board of 30 members. Chanakya's Arthasastra. District under a sthanika; gopas in charge of five to ten villages.

en.q: The Mauryan municipal administration of Pataliputra was headed by a:
en.explanation: The nagaraka headed six committees of five members each; sthanika headed a district.

ta.q: பாடலிபுத்திர நகர நிர்வாகத்துக்குத் தலைமை வகித்தவர் யார்?
ta.explanation: நாகரகரின் கீழ் ஐவர் கொண்ட ஆறு குழுக்கள் செயல்பட்டன; மாவட்டத்தை ஸ்தானிகர் நிர்வகித்தார்.

questions.quote: Nalanda was a great monastery built by the Magadha Empire. It was supported by the revenues of 100 villages. No fees were charged to the students and they were provided free board and lodging.

en.q: The great monastic university of Nalanda was supported by the revenues of how many villages?
en.explanation: Nalanda was supported by the revenue of 100 villages; students had free board and lodging.

ta.q: நாலந்தா பல்கலைக்கழகம் எத்தனை கிராமங்களின் வருவாயால் ஆதரிக்கப்பட்டது?
ta.explanation: 100 கிராமங்களின் வருவாயால் ஆதரிக்கப்பட்டது; மாணவர்களுக்குக் கட்டணமின்றி உணவு, தங்குமிடம்.
